    Open lobbies

    To play together, share this page with the people you want to play, then have each of them open it and choose Multiplayer. Everyone needs to be signed in to Claude. Keep the game tab in front while you play: a hidden tab pauses the battle for everyone. If you drop out of a battle (a closed tab, a reload, a lost connection), come back here and choose Rejoin to take command of your army again, as long as someone else is still in that battle.

    Campaign · Conquest

    The Dawgs Ocean

    Eight continents, one enemy army. Each turn, sail your aircraft carriers along the sea lanes and send bomber wings against enemy continents. Landing on an enemy continent starts a battle on its shores: take the enemy fortress and the continent is yours. Continents pay credits every turn. Spend them on new carriers and on bonuses for your next battle. Where carriers meet, the battle is fought at sea: carrier against carrier on the open ocean, and the side whose carrier is sunk loses the continent's waters.

    Controls
    Left dragBox-select your units (click to pick one, Shift to add, double-click for all of a type) Right clickMove to ground, or attack the enemy under the cursor Right dragDraw a line: selected units spread out evenly along it F then clickFight-move: advance and engage anything on the way HHalt Radar StationWith fog on, enemy units inside its range show as red blips on the map and minimap, without saying what they are. Its range is the dashed circle on the minimap I or PingPing: click a spot on the map or minimap. Everyone on your team sees a beacon and gets an alert StancesIn the command card's Orders tab: Aggressive (engage and chase), Hold ground (fire in range, never move off) or Return fire (only shoot back) Unit listThe bottom bar lists your selection by type with a count: click a type to keep only those, Shift-click to drop them. Ctrl+A selects all military units, Tab opens the scoreboard Base typesFortresses field the whole army and are hardest to take. Towns earn the most money and manpower. Airbases build and service aircraft. Ports (⚓) can build a Dockyard for boats. A base can't be captured until its garrison and defences are destroyed Construction Rover (E at an HQ)Select it and open its Build tab: pick a building, move the hologram inside the base's yellow ring, mouse wheel to turn it, click to build. Rovers must stay at the site while it goes up; more rovers build faster. Right-click a site to send rovers to it. Up to 3 rovers Man wallsWith infantry or artillery selected: Orders tab, or right-click your Fortress's walls. Infantry hold the wall walks, artillery the gun pits; they take less damage and are harder to hit. Any order brings them down Click your baseLists its buildings (each base holds a limited number): upgrade or demolish them from the command card. Double-click or G zooms in Click your zone, right clickSet a rally point for the troops that zone builds WASD / arrows / edgePan camera. Wheel to zoom, middle-drag to pan, click the minimap to jump Z X C V B N J K L U Y R O · Shift+TTrain units at the building whose card is open (Barracks: Z X C, Motor Pool: V B N J ⇧T R, Foundry: K L, Helipad: U ⇧U, Dockyard: Y O). E raises a Construction Rover at the deploy point. A base's Recruit tab only raises rovers and lists its buildings under Train at Q or Missile buttonAim a ballistic missile from your HQ (one built every 2 minutes per HQ, up to 3). Auto fires them for you Rally allClick the ground: every zone, including ones you capture later, sends its new troops there Heavy AirshipA mega unit: order it at a base with a finished Helipad ($1400, one per army at a time). Slow, five guns, huge armor: it takes AA, Heavy Anti-Air Vehicles, rockets and fighters to bring down. Repairs at an HQ or Fortress Field HospitalA base upgrade in the Base tab: troops there heal three times faster from further out, and vehicles get repaired AirbasesPlanes taxi, take off from the runway and rearm at the terminals. When every terminal is taken they circle until one frees up. Lose the airbase and they must reach another one Aircraft buttonSelect all planes. Auto: they pick targets. Manual: right-click a target or area for one sortie Shift+1–9 / 1–9Save / recall control groups Space · P · EscJump to HQ · pause time · pause menu TYour bases: a full-screen list of every base you hold, its buildings, production and statistics M · Shift+MFull-screen map (wheel zooms, drag pans, click to jump, right-click to move) · mute music
